strategy.name: intraday_dynamic_sma200_robust_ab_selection
strategy.description: 完全沿用既有盘前可解的动态 SMA200 双阈值交易语义，固定 c=d=5%、5 bps 单边成本，在 2000-01-03 至 2025-12-31 连续运行每组 a/b；持仓、现金、成本价和上次卖出价跨年份连续传递，再以滚动五年下四分位、空仓重启十年敏感性、局部平台、PBO 和 DSR 选择唯一稳健代表，同时详细展示全历史 CAGR 与 Sharpe 机械冠军作为参照。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓普通入场：前一完成 Close 不高于前一完成 SMA200×(1+b%) 时保留向上穿越资格；当日价格达到 P=(1+b%)×(此前199个完成Close之和+P)/200 时买入。已有卖出时，同时放置上次计成本卖出成交价×1.05 的纠错买回线；两条向上触发线取较低者优先。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时常驻普通卖出线 P=(1-a%)×(此前199个完成Close之和+P)/200，同时放置上次计成本买入成交价×0.95 的纠错卖出线；两条向下触发线取较高者优先。
strategy.signal_time: 每个常规交易日开盘前，只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完成历史与既有实际账户成交价，解出当日全部资格和触发价。
strategy.execution_time: 若常规时段 Open 已越过预挂触发线则按 Open 成交，否则调整后日线 OHLC 触及时按精确理论线成交；随后施加单边5 bps不利成本；每日最多一笔。
strategy.positioning: long-only；2000-01-03 以100,000美元现金空仓开始；每次买入投入全部现金、每次卖出清空全部份额；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。

parameters.requested_interval: 2000-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive; normalized to available QQQ sessions
parameters.state_continuity: Each a/b case runs once from analysis_start through analysis_end. Cash, shares, effective cost basis and last effective sell fill are never reset at calendar or rolling-window boundaries.

rolling_five_year.calendar_windows: 2000-2004 through 2021-2025, advancing one calendar year at a time
rolling_five_year.state_handling: Performance is rebased at each window boundary but strategy state is inherited from the single continuous run.
rolling_five_year.primary_statistic: 25th percentile of the 22 rolling five-year CAGRs (S5)

identifiability_gate.purpose: Exclude one-entry hold artifacts and cases in which the ordinary a/b rules were not meaningfully exercised. Correction counts are reported but not gated.

restart_sensitivity.duration: ten calendar years inclusive, ending December 31 of start_year+9
restart_sensitivity.initial_state: Each sensitivity run independently restarts flat with 100,000 USD; pre-start data is warmup only.
restart_sensitivity.statistic: 25th percentile of the 17 ten-year restart CAGRs (S10)
restart_sensitivity.gate: S10 must be strictly positive and at or above the 75th percentile among identifiable cases. This is a gate, not a weighted objective.

stable_plateau.connectivity: four-neighbor connectivity among restart-gated cases in the top decile of S5
stable_plateau.component_rule: Choose the largest component; ties prefer the higher component-median S5.
stable_plateau.local_score: median S5 over a±0.5%, b±1.0% minus 0.5 times its population standard deviation
stable_plateau.representative_tiebreakers: higher S10, then closer to component geometric centroid, then higher point S5

pbo.method: Combinatorially Symmetric Cross-Validation over 12 contiguous approximately equal-bar blocks
pbo.selection_metric: annualized daily Sharpe reconstructed from block return moments
pbo.strategy_universe: all full-history cases that pass the identifiability gate
pbo.overfit_event: the in-sample Sharpe winner ranks at or below the median on the complementary blocks

dsr.primary_trial_count: correlation-adjusted effective number of identifiable strategies using 12-block log-return vectors
dsr.historical_count_basis: three prior 155,526-case a/b/cost scans plus the current 6,909-case grid; deliberately conservative and not de-duplicated
dsr.candidate: the single stable representative chosen before DSR is evaluated

reference_anchor.purpose: Predeclared comparison only; it receives no preference in selection.

supplementary_metrics.full_history_cagr: Show the complete surface and formally verify its mechanical maximum; never replace S5 as the primary objective.
supplementary_metrics.full_history_sharpe: Show the complete surface and formally verify its mechanical maximum; never replace S5 as the primary objective.
supplementary_metrics.rolling_five_year_sharpe: Report lower quartile and median for interpretation only.
supplementary_metrics.risk_and_activity: Report maximum drawdown, exposure and all signal counts, but do not impose the previously rejected drawdown or longest-cash gates.

parameters.final_decision: The unique representative passes only if the plateau span/boundary test, PBO<=20%, and effective-trials DSR>=95% all pass. If any fails, conclude that no credible fixed a/b has yet been established; do not substitute the runner-up.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD at the 2000-01-03 regular-session Open with 5 bps adverse entry cost and hold QQQ through 2025-12-31. The benchmark is descriptive and does not enter parameter selection.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged. Build experiment-specific S5, S10, full-history CAGR and Sharpe heatmaps plus candidate/window diagnostics in the analyzer; do not promote those research-specific plots into the generic template.
reporting.report_title: QQQ SMA200 a/b 全历史稳健选参
reporting.report_subtitle: 连续状态滚动五年下分位为主；十年空仓起点、局部平台、PBO/DSR 为门禁；全历史 CAGR 与 Sharpe 为详细参照。

research.hypothesis: 固定 c=d=5% 后，a 大约0%至6%、b 大约-20%至-10%附近可能存在一个不依赖单一历史起点、且在滚动五年下限与十年空仓重启中仍然稳定的宽参数平台。
research.primary_metric: S5: the 25th percentile of 22 state-preserving rolling five-year CAGRs. Full-history CAGR and Sharpe are detailed supplementary surfaces and cannot override S5.
research.selection_rule: Apply the declared activity gate; apply the positive/top-quartile S10 restart gate; take the largest four-neighbor component among gated top-decile S5 cells; require declared a/b spans and no search-boundary contact; select the highest declared local robustness score with frozen tie-breakers. Evaluate PBO and DSR only after this unique representative is fixed.
research.validation_plan: Save all 6,909 full-history cases, all 22 rolling-window results, all 17 flat-restart results, all 924 CSCV splits and statistical summaries. Formally reconcile the unique representative, full-history CAGR maximum, full-history Sharpe maximum, S5 maximum, S10 maximum and predeclared anchor with PyBroker and the independent daily ledger within 1e-6. Require tests, source/artifact hashes, workspace audit and real Chrome report interaction.
research.promotion_criteria: No direct promotion from this in-sample research. A fixed candidate is only nominated when the plateau structural gate, PBO<=20% and effective-trials DSR>=95% all pass; once frozen, 2026 onward remains the chronological forward period and may not be used to retune a/b.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the fixed-parameter claim if no identifiable cases survive, the stable component is too narrow or touches a search boundary, PBO exceeds 20%, effective-trials DSR is below 95%, the result depends on replacing the predeclared primary objective with full-history CAGR/Sharpe, or any accounting, timing, count, hash, test, audit or browser gate fails.
